title: STILL-PRESENT: W-2 pool-cap clamp excludes cap 1 — a cap-1 Pool_Exhaustion crisis can never resolve (probe-confirmed permanent crisis)
detail: Guard `cap > 1` leaves cap 1 at margin 2: resolve needs len+2<1, impossible. Cap 1 is legal (validation rejects only ≤0). Probe: one trigger, zero resolves, active Pool_Exhaustion row at tick 4000 — fairness rule 4 broken.
recommended_fix: Clamp cap 1 too: `if u32(cap) <= pool_margin { pool_margin = u32(cap) - 1 }` (cap 1 → margin 0 → len+0<1 reachable), or validate pool_max_packets >= 2 at load.

title: The r3 W-2 clamp branches have zero test coverage — the change-log's 'authoring-time caps covered' is false
evidence:
Every pool-cap assignment in core/crisis_test.odin:
core/crisis_test.odin:289:	cat.balance.pool_max_packets = 16 // a small pool — the backstop engages fast (and drains after the fix: steady-state in-flight ~10 fits under it)
core/crisis_test.odin:454:	cat.balance.pool_max_packets = 100000
core/crisis_test.odin:712:	cat.balance.pool_max_packets = 10
core/crisis_test.odin:770:	cat.balance.pool_max_packets = 14 // small enough to be at-cap at 1200
The clamped branches:
core/crisis.odin:409:			if cat.balance.pool_max_packets > 1 && u32(cat.balance.pool_max_packets) <= pool_margin {
core/crisis.odin:485:			len(state.flow.packets) + int(min(CRISIS_RESOLVE_MARGIN, u32(max(1, cat.balance.pool_max_packets)) - 1)) >= int(cat.balance.pool_max_packets) {
The claimed coverage (spec-4-2-surge-crisis.md:240):
    unaffected (authoring-time caps covered).
detail: No crisis test uses pool caps 1-2, so the clamp never executes its clamped path (qos_test's cap-2 fixtures are era-0 E22 ladder tests — crisis_evaluate no-ops). The cap-1 defect shipped undetected precisely because this branch is untested.
recommended_fix: Add cap-2 and cap-1 pool-crisis tests mirroring test_crisis_pool_exhaustion's shape: trigger @1200, player fix routes the pool, assert final Crisis_Resolved and empty active rows.

title: STILL-PRESENT: N-5's 'ANY-class pool discriminator pinned' claim is false — the added assertion never isolates a non-surge shed firing the crisis
detail: sla[0].dropped aggregates every drop reason across the whole run and never isolates the @1200 trigger tick; streaming (the surge class) sheds every in-window tick, so the trigger could key on the surge's own shed and the assertion still passes. The discriminator stays unpinned.
recommended_fix: Construct a tick where the ONLY pool shed is a non-surge class (surge demand routed elsewhere) and assert the crisis still fires — the discriminator's actual pin.

title: The r3 N-4 pool-banner title fix has no pin — the Pool_Exhaustion banner variant remains string- and pixel-untested
detail: The shortened title is the branch rendering the map-wide cause, yet no blessed T2 capture shows it (surge/warn/qos demos all fire Saturated_Bundle crises) and no test pins the string. An overflow or regression here is invisible.
recommended_fix: Bless one pool-crisis T2 capture (a pool-limited demo) or add a render-string unit pin for the pool title fitting the 440px card.

title: Lint gate 6 scans only literals — banner strings sourced from data/crises.json bypass the N-12 mojibake gate
evidence:
tools/lint.sh:54 (the scan corpus):
for _f in app/render/*.odin app/main.odin; do
app/render/crisis.odin renders catalog data through draw_text_c:
45:			arch = cat.crises[ac.archetype].display_name
64:			title = fmt.aprintf("!!  %s: %s ACTIVE - pool exhausted",
71:			redesign = cat.crises[ac.archetype].preventive_redesign
detail: draw_crisis_banner feeds data/crises.json strings (display_name, preventive_redesign) through the byte-truncating draw_text_c, but gate 6 never scans data/*.json — a non-ASCII archetype string renders mojibake with all gates green.
recommended_fix: Extend gate 6 to scan data/*.json string values, or fail-fast at catalogs_load (ASCII check on crisis display strings) alongside the existing validation rows.

title: The B3 fix's cooldown-blocked-(a) fall-through to the (c) pool backstop is unpinned by any test
detail: No test combines a cooldown-blocked (a) hit with a same-tick pool E22 shed; the branch where `triggered` stays false and (c) fires is unreachable in the suite. The N4 semantic B3 claims to preserve can regress silently.
recommended_fix: Add a test: cooldown > 0, (a) hits a blocked pair, pool sheds same tick — assert the Pool_Exhaustion crisis still fires (one trigger, one row).

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 100%: trigger/dedup/resolve/serialization/catalog fail-fast fully pinned; suite green (125 tests; only the two untracked W-2 probes fail); B3 pinned at cap 14 and probe-verified at 11-13. P1 80-89%: pool-cap 1-2 clamp, cooldown fall-through, ANY-class discriminator, pool banner variant unpinned.
recommended_fix: Add tests: pool-cap 1-2 crisis resolve, email-only-shed pool trigger, cooldown-blocked-(a)+pool-shed fall-through, and a pool-banner T2 capture; re-run the gate afterwards.
